Which SQL query below correctly demonstrates an inner join, and what tables does it connect? 

SELECT a.authors.a_fname, a.authors.a_lname, b.books.title, b.books.roalty 
FROM authors a 
INNER JOIN titleauthor ta ON a.authors.a_id = ta.au_id 
INNER JOIN books b ON ta.title_id = b.title_id 
GROUP BY a.authors.a_lname, a.authors.a_fname, b.books.title, b.books.roalty 
ORDER BY a.authors.a_lname
